description: Juan Reyes Sierra, identified in the recording context as a UCF senior, shares his father’s account of September 11, 2001; Reyes Sierra says he was not yet born at the time. His father was a manager at the Colony Beach and Resort in Longboat Key, Florida, and was with President Bush there on the morning of September 11. Reyes Sierra says his father was responsible for logistics and recalled that they spent about a week preparing a brunch menu for Bush. His father took a photograph with Bush, which Reyes Sierra refers to while telling the story. Reyes Sierra recounts his father’s report that Sarasota Airport was shut down and that fighter jets were present; he says people thought the president might be targeted. The account is presented as inherited family memory, not as Reyes Sierra’s personal experience of the events. The recording context gives a recording date of September 11, 2026, and identifies the collection as UCF Remembers 9/11.
